AzureAISearch.description: Configures the connection to the Azure AI Search service. Unless 'DisableUIConfiguration' is enabled, a tenant can override these values from its Azure AI Search settings. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/AzureAISearch/.

Endpoint.description: The Azure AI Search service endpoint, e.g. 'https://[search service name].search.windows.net'.

AuthenticationType.description: The authentication type: 'Default' for the default Azure credential, 'ManagedIdentity' for managed-identity authentication, or 'ApiKey' for key-based authentication. 'ApiKey' is used when 'Credential:Key' is provided.

IdentityClientId.description: The client id of a user-assigned managed identity. When not set, the system-assigned identity is used.

Credential.description: The credential used by the 'ApiKey' authentication type.

Key.description: The Azure AI Search service key.

IndexesPrefix.description: A prefix added to the name of all indexes, e.g. the environment name to prevent naming conflicts when the same service is shared by production and staging.

Analyzers.description: The names of the analyzers that can be selected for an index. Defaults to all the built-in Azure AI Search lexical analyzers.

DisableUIConfiguration.description: Whether to disable the per-tenant configuration from the admin UI, so that all tenants use the values defined in this section.

OrchardCore_AzureAISearch.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_AzureAISearch' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Search:AzureAISearch' instead.
